settings.heading: Products, Pre-Orders & Shipping
settings.body: Find answers about REÚ products, ingredients, formats, pre-orders, shipping, cancellations, and returns.

settings.question: What is REÚ?
settings.answer: REÚ is a premium wellness supplement brand created for women. Our products are designed to make everyday wellness simple, enjoyable, and easier to fit into real life.

settings.question: How do I choose the right product?
settings.answer: Start with your main wellness goal, browse Shop by Goal, or take our Product Recommendation Quiz for a guided starting point.

settings.question: What is the difference between Pouches and Sachets?
settings.answer: Pouches are designed for a consistent at-home routine. Sachets provide convenient single serves for work, travel, workouts, and busy days. Confirm serving equivalence on each product page.

settings.question: How should I use my product?
settings.answer: Always follow the directions shown on the product label and product page. Do not exceed the recommended serving.

settings.question: Where can I find ingredients and allergens?
settings.answer: Every product page includes supplier-verified ingredients, Supplement Facts, allergen information, directions, and warnings.

settings.question: Can I use more than one REÚ product?
settings.answer: Some products may fit together, but suitability depends on their verified ingredients and your individual circumstances. Compare labels and consult a qualified healthcare professional if you take medication, have a health condition, or are unsure.

settings.question: Are REÚ products suitable during pregnancy or nursing?
settings.answer: Speak with a qualified healthcare professional before using any supplement during pregnancy or while nursing.

settings.question: Are the products vegan, gluten-free, or free from added sugar?
settings.answer: Dietary attributes vary by product and will be stated on the product page only when supported by supplier documentation.

settings.question: Are products currently in stock?
settings.answer: The initial REÚ release is available for pre-order. Products are not yet ready for immediate shipment.

settings.question: When will pre-orders ship?
settings.answer: Pre-orders are expected to ship within the estimated window shown at checkout and on our Shipping Policy page.

settings.question: When will I be charged?
settings.answer: Your payment timing is displayed clearly before you confirm your purchase.

settings.question: Can I cancel my pre-order?
settings.answer: Yes. You may request cancellation for a full refund at any time before shipment by contacting our support team with your order number.

settings.question: What happens if shipping is delayed?
settings.answer: We will email you with a revised estimated shipping date and explain your option to continue waiting or cancel for a prompt full refund.

settings.question: Can pre-order and in-stock items be purchased together?
settings.answer: We recommend separate checkouts so in-stock items are not held until pre-order items are ready.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, we will email tracking details to the address used at checkout.

settings.question: How do I contact REÚ?
settings.answer: Use our Contact page and our team will get back to you. Support hours are shown on the Contact page.
